import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem unique_normal_sylow_of_card_eq_mul {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp_bound : 25 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 100)
    (hG : Nat.card G = 24 * p) :
    ∃ P : Sylow p G, p ∣ Nat.card G ∧ P.Normal ∧ ∀ Q : Sylow p G, Q = P := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let P : Sylow p G := default
  
  have hdiv : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ Nat.card G := by
    exact (Sylow.card_dvd_index P).trans P.index_dvd_card
  
  have hdiv24p : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ 24 * p := hG ▸ hdiv
  
  have hnot : ¬p ∣ Nat.card (Sylow p G) :=
    not_dvd_card_sylow p G
  
  have hcop : (Nat.card (Sylow p G)).Coprime p := by
    exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).2 hnot |>.symm
  
  have hdiv24 : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ 24 :=
    hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdiv24p
  
  have hle : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≤ 24 :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv24
  
  have hmod : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p] :=
    card_sylow_modEq_one p G
  
  have hone : Nat.card (Sylow p G) = 1 := by
    apply hmod.eq_of_lt_of_lt
    · omega
    · omega
  
  letI : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hone).1
  
  have hnormal : P.Normal :=
    Sylow.normal_of_subsingleton P
  
  refine ⟨P, ?_, hnormal, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨24, by rw [hG]; ring⟩
  · intro Q
    exact Subsingleton.elim Q P

    (hG : Nat.card G = 24 * p) :
    ∃ P : Sylow p G, p ∣ Nat.card G ∧ P.Normal ∧ ∀ Q : Sylow p G, Q = P := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : Finite (Sylow p G) :=
    Finite.of_injective (fun P : Sylow p G => (P : Subgroup G))
      (by
        intro P Q h
        exact Sylow.ext h)
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := Sylow.nonempty (p := p) (G := G)
  have hpd : p ∣ Nat.card G := by
    rw [hG]
    exact dvd_mul_left p 24
  have hpc : p ∣ Nat.card P := P.dvd_card_of_dvd_card hpd
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hpc
  have hidx : P.index * Nat.card P = Nat.card G :=
    Subgroup.index_mul_card P.1
  have hidx24 : P.index ∣ 24 := by
    rw [hG, hk] at hidx
    have hmul : p * (P.index * k) = p * 24 := by
      simpa [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm] using hidx
    have hik : P.index * k ∣ 24 :=
      Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left hp.pos (dvd_of_eq hmul)
    exact (dvd_mul_right P.index k).trans hik
  have hnd : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ P.index :=
    P.card_dvd_index
  have hn24 : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ 24 :=
    hnd.trans hidx24
  have hnle : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≤ 24 :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hn24
  have hmod := card_sylow_modEq_one p G
  have hnpos : 1 ≤ Nat.card (Sylow p G) :=
    Nat.card_pos
  have hsub : p ∣ Nat.card (Sylow p G) - 1 :=
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hnpos).mp hmod.symm
  have hzero : Nat.card (Sylow p G) - 1 = 0 :=
    Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hsub (by omega)
  have hone : Nat.card (Sylow p G) = 1 := by
    omega
  letI : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hone).1
  have hnormal : P.Normal :=
    Sylow.normal_of_subsingleton P
  exact ⟨P, hpd, hnormal, fun Q => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
